title.en: Pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein - how Italian children became so overweight
title.zh: 披萨、意面、土豆、蛋白质——意大利儿童为何超重

summary.en: Despite the Mediterranean diet being a model for healthy living, Italian children are now among the most overweight in Europe, according to the WHO.
summary.zh: 世界卫生组织指出，尽管地中海饮食是健康生活的典范，但意大利儿童目前却是欧洲超重儿童比例最高的群体之一。

body.en:
Daily life is not easy for Salvatore. At 17, he weighs 170kg (26st 10lb) and struggles to walk.

He can't tie his own shoelaces and his Vespa scooter strains to bear his weight - in one week, its wheels broke seven times.

Salvatore is among a growing number of Italian children and teenagers living with obesity. The problem is particularly acute in the south: in parts of the Campania region, more than 40% of eight and nine-year-olds are overweight. The town of Ponticelli, on the outskirts of Naples, has earned the unenviable reputation as one of the world's child obesity capitals.

It is a striking development in a country long regarded as the spiritual home of the Mediterranean diet. Yet today, Italian children are among the most overweight in Europe, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

Salvatore is waiting for life-changing surgery at the Betania Hospital in Ponticelli, where Dr Sonja Chiappetta has spent 15 years treating patients with severe obesity.

Until recently, she says, most of her patients were in their fifties. "Now I see those same patients when they're teenagers, as young as 16. They are getting younger, and it's frightening."

The surgery she carries out removes up to 90% of the stomach - meaning people are unable to eat large quantities of food. Demand has risen sharply in this part of Italy.

But Salvatore has been told he cannot get the operation. His weight is so excessive it makes the surgery too dangerous.

Instead, Dr Chiappetta has prescribed him a GLP-1 weight-loss injection to reduce his appetite and help him lose enough weight for the operation.

The Mediterranean diet - rich in vegetables, legumes, olive oil, whole grains and fish - became famous after US physiologist Ancel Keys and his wife, biochemist Margaret Keys, studied communities in southern Italy in the 1950s and linked their habits to remarkably low rates of heart disease.

Their research transformed a regional way of eating into one of the world's best-known diets; a blueprint for healthy living.

"The traditional Mediterranean diet has been lost," says Doctor Valter Longo, director of the Longevity Institute at the University of Southern California. "Only 10% of Italians really follow it."

Dr Longo sums up the modern Italian diet with what he calls the "five Ps": pizza, pasta, potatoes, protein and pane - the Italian word for bread.

The transformation is visible everywhere: from supermarket shelves stocked with ultra-processed foods to pizzerias selling slices piled high with chips, sausages and fried snacks.

Doctor Roberto Berni Canani, a paediatrician and obesity specialist at the Federico II University in Naples, sees the consequences every day.

"I've treated children who are just two or three years old and already weigh 25kg," he...
body.zh: 萨尔瓦多的日常生活并不轻松。 17 岁时，他体重 170 公斤（26 磅 10 磅），走路很困难。 他无法自己系鞋带，他的 Vespa 踏板车也难以承受他的体重 - 一周内，车轮坏了七次。 萨尔瓦托是越来越多患有肥胖症的意大利儿童和青少年之一。这个问题在南部地区尤为严重：在坎帕尼亚地区的部分地区，超过 40% 的八岁和九岁儿童体重超重。位于那不勒斯郊区的蓬蒂切利镇赢得了世界儿童肥胖之都之一的名声。 对于一个长期被视为地中海饮食精神家园的国家来说，这是一个惊人的发展。然而，据世界卫生组织 (WHO) 称，如今，意大利儿童是欧洲超重儿童最多的国家之一。 Salvatore 正在 Ponticelli 的 Betania 医院等待改变生活的手术，Sonja Chiappetta 医生已经在那里治疗严重肥胖症患者 15 年。 她说，直到最近，她的大多数病人都在五十多岁。 “现在我看到同样的病人在青少年时期，最小的只有 16 岁。他们变得越来越年轻，这很可怕。” 她进行的手术切除了高达 90% 的胃——这意味着人们无法吃大量的食物。意大利这一地区的需求急剧上升。 但萨尔瓦托被告知他无法接受手术。他的体重太重了，手术太危险了。 相反，Chiappetta 医生给他开了 GLP-1 减肥注射液，以减少他的食欲，帮助他减掉足够的体重以进行手术。 美国生理学家安塞尔·凯斯 (Ancel Keys) 和他的妻子、生物化学家玛格丽特·凯斯 (Margaret Keys) 在 20 世纪 50 年代对意大利南部的社区进行了研究，并将他们的习惯与极低的心脏病发病率联系起来后，富含蔬菜、豆类、橄榄油、全谷物和鱼类的地中海饮食开始闻名。 他们的研究将当地的饮食方式转变为世界上最著名的饮食方式之一。健康生活的蓝图。 “传统的地中海饮食已经消失，”南加州大学长寿研究所所长瓦尔特·隆戈博士说。 “只有 10% 的意大利人真正遵循它。” 隆戈博士用他所谓的“五个P”来总结现代意大利饮食：披萨、意大利面、土豆、蛋白质和窗格（意大利语中面包的意思）。 这种转变随处可见：从摆满超加工食品的超市货架到出售堆满薯片、香肠和油炸小吃的披萨店。 那不勒斯费德里科二世大学的儿科医生和肥胖症专家罗伯托·贝尔尼·卡纳尼医生每天都会看到这种后果。 “我治疗过的孩子只有两三岁，体重已经达到 25 公斤，”他...

reflection.en: This news highlights how foundational early habits are for a child's long-term well-being. When traditional blueprints for healthy living are set aside, the impact on the next generation can be significant, underscoring the importance of guiding children toward beneficial practices from a young age.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了早期习惯对孩子长期福祉的奠基作用。当传统的健康生活蓝图被搁置时，对下一代的影响可能非常深远，这突显了从小引导孩子养成有益习惯的重要性。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: One killed and 15 injured after van crashes into crowd at Berlin Pride
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行因汽车撞入人群而取消

summary.en: A major incident occurred in Berlin when a car crashed into a crowd near the route of the Christopher Street Day Pride parade, causing several injuries. The event was subsequently called off.
summary.zh: 柏林克里斯托弗街日骄傲游行路线附近发生一起重大事件，一辆汽车撞入人群，造成多人受伤。该活动随后被取消。

body.en: Police call off annual parade hours after it began as several people are struck by vehicle in Tiergarten park A van has ploughed into a crowd at Berlin’s annual LGBTQ+ pride parade, killing at least one person and injuring about 15, police said, leading them to call off the event hours after it had begun to protect participants. Police said those hurt “included several with life-threatening injuries”. They called on everyone to leave the event, one of Europe’s largest LGBTQ+ celebrations, immediately, in a post on X. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据报道，一辆汽车撞向人群，造成多人受伤，柏林宣布发生重大事故。 周六晚上在游行路线附近的蒂尔加滕公园发生事件后，该市的克里斯托弗街日骄傲游行被组织者取消。 警方在 WhatsApp 上发帖称：“我们认为，一辆车进入蒂尔加滕公园，撞到了多人，导致多人受伤。”并补充说，他们正在积极寻找责任人。

reflection.en: News of unexpected harm and suffering, especially during a public celebration, reminds us of the pain present in our world. Yet, we hold onto the hope that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more mourning, crying, or pain. This promise offers solace and strength when confronted with such distressing events.
reflection.zh: 突如其来的伤害和痛苦，尤其是在公共庆祝活动中发生，提醒我们世间仍有苦难。然而，我们怀抱希望，相信雅伟终有一天会擦去所有的眼泪，不再有悲伤、哭泣或痛苦。这个应许在面对此类令人痛心的事件时，能带给我们安慰和力量。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: One dead and 15 injured after 'horrific act' at Berlin Pride event
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行活动发生“可怕事件”，一人死亡，15人受伤

summary.en: One person was killed and 15 others were injured in a "horrific act" at a Berlin Pride event. Police later located the car believed to be involved, which had been abandoned.
summary.zh: 在柏林骄傲游行活动中发生了一起“可怕的事件”，造成一人死亡，另有15人受伤。警方表示，他们已找到涉事车辆，该车已被遗弃。

body.en:
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed Sunday to punish the perpetrators of a car-ramming attack that killed one person and injured several others on the fringes of Berlin's Gay Pride parade.

At least one person has been killed, and around 15 wounded, police said on Saturday.

"We believe that a vehicle entered the Tiergarten park and hit several people and injured them," police posted on social media, later adding that they were hunting for the occupants of the car.

Merz said in a statement that he and Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt would "push to make sure this horrific act is fully investigated and punished".

The mayor of Berlin said "freedom has come under attack in the most horrific way".

Kai Wegner said in a post on X that the "gathering for a tolerant and peaceful Berlin has been most brutally attacked".

Police spokesman Florian Nath said some of the survivors were "seriously" injured and are being treated by emergency services.

Police told AFP they had found the car they thought had been involved in the incident abandoned.

The Gay Pride event was cut short, and police told participants to "Go home, please" and sealed off the area where the people were injured.

An eyewitness by the main Pride stage at Brandenburg Gate said the crowd complied with the request to leave and head away from the park shortly at around 11:00 pm.

An AFP journalist in the area saw at least 10 emergency service vehicles at the scene and a tent set up in the road.

Earlier Saturday, hundreds of thousands of people took part in the event, called Christopher Street Day in Germany.

The march ended next to the Brandenburg Gate, which has been the venue for concerts since Friday.

Germany has in recent years seen several violent attacks at public spaces, including a stabbing in February 2025 at Berlin's Holocaust memorial, a stone's throw from the scene of Saturday's incident.

body.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨周日发誓要惩罚柏林同性恋骄傲游行边缘发生的汽车撞击袭击事件的肇事者，该袭击事件导致一人死亡、多人受伤。 警方周六表示，至少有 1 人死亡，约 15 人受伤。 警方在社交媒体上发帖称：“我们认为，一辆车进入蒂尔加滕公园，撞到了几人，导致多人受伤。”警方随后补充说，他们正在寻找车上的人。 默茨在一份声明中表示，他和内政部长亚历山大·多布林特将“努力确保这一可怕的行为得到充分调查和惩罚”。 柏林市长表示“自由受到了最可怕的攻击”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 凯·韦格纳 (Kai Wegner) 在 X 上发帖称，“为了宽容与和平的柏林而举行的集会遭到了最残酷的攻击”。 警方发言人弗洛里安·纳斯表示，一些幸存者“严重”受伤，正在接受紧急服务机构的治疗。 警方告诉法新社，他们发现那辆他们认为与这起事件有关的汽车被遗弃了。 同性恋骄傲活动被缩短，警方告诉参与者“请回家”，并封锁了人们受伤的地区。 勃兰登堡门骄傲节主舞台的一名目击者表示，人群在晚上 11:00 左右响应了离开公园的要求。 一名法新社记者在该地区看到，现场至少有10辆紧急服务车辆，路边还搭起了帐篷。 周六早些时候，数十万人参加了德国的克里斯托弗街日活动。 游行在勃兰登堡门旁边结束，自周五以来，这里一直是音乐会的举办地。 德国近年来发生了多起针对公共场所的暴力袭击事件，包括 2025 年 2 月在距离周六事件现场仅一箭之遥的柏林大屠杀纪念馆发生的刺伤事件。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The tragic violence at the Berlin Pride event reminds us of the sacred worth of every individual. Yahweh created humanity in His own image, bestowing inherent dignity upon all people, regardless of their identity or background. In moments of such senseless harm, we are called to remember and uphold the profound value of each life.
reflection.zh: 柏林骄傲游行活动中发生的悲剧性暴力事件提醒我们，每个个体都拥有神圣的价值。雅伟照着自己的形象创造了人类，赋予所有人固有的尊严，无论其身份或背景如何。在面对这种毫无意义的伤害时，我们被呼召去铭记并维护每一条生命的深远价值。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Smash hit: How Alex Eala's Wimbledon run made everyday Filipinos fall in love with tennis
title.zh: 一鸣惊人：亚历克斯·埃亚拉的温网之旅如何让普通菲律宾人爱上网球

summary.en: Tennis is experiencing a surge in popularity in the Philippines, a country traditionally focused on basketball and boxing. This boom is attributed to Alex Eala's successful run at Wimbledon, making the sport accessible to everyday Filipinos.
summary.zh: 网球在菲律宾这个传统上痴迷于篮球和拳击的国家，正经历着人气飙升。这一热潮归因于亚历克斯·埃亚拉在温布尔登的成功表现，使这项运动对普通菲律宾人来说变得触手可及。

body.en:
Chasing her dream of becoming a world tennis champion, teen athlete Maristella Torrecampo and her father took a gruelling 13-hour bus from her sleepy hillside hometown for her latest match in Manila.

The 14-year-old's mum and four siblings could not join to watch her play; her crowdfunded budget was only enough for two round-trip bus tickets and a few days' worth of meals.

Barely rested from the long journey, and with only her father cheering her on, Torrecampo crushed her Omani opponent in straight sets 6-1, 6-1 on that sweltering Tuesday afternoon at the Rizal Stadium, keeping alive her dream of following in the footsteps of Alexandra Eala, the country's newest sports star.

Torrecampo competed in Manila in July as the Philippines was celebrating Eala's historic Wimbledon run - one that Torrecampo and the entire nation followed on streaming and social media.

Eala, 21, went the farthest any Filipina had gone in a Grand Slam event, reaching the fourth round and eliminating defending champion Iga Swiatek of Poland along the way.

Since her breakout semi-final performance at the Miami Open last year, Eala has re-ignited interest in tennis in the Philippines, a country obsessed with the three B's - basketball, boxing and beauty queens.

"Like Ate Alex, I want to win at Wimbledon, WTA, and various tournaments around the world," Torrecampo said, referring to Eala with the Filipino word for elder sister.

"She inspired me so much. I looked up to her since I was little," said Torrecampo, who has competed in the Philippine National Games, and in tournaments in Cambodia and Sri Lanka.

"I like her attitude off and on court. Off court, she is really humble. There are a lot of kids like me who look up to her."

Eala came home from London to a hero's welcome, with President Ferdinand Marcos hosting a reception in her honour at Malacanang Palace in Manila.

"I'm so grateful that I am able to share my triumphs, most especially my recent run at Wimbledon, with the country," Eala said at the reception.

"As we say, this is our victory. I cannot begin to describe how overjoyed I am to see how my progress has been received by the Filipino people."

Tennis is an elite sport in the Philippines, an archipelago nation of 112 million people.

Decades of American colonial rule bequeathed the nation with a passion for basketball. Every village has a basketball court and Filipinos are more likely to recognise LeBron James than Roger Federer.

Filipinos' love for rags-to-riches underdog stories and big personalities have also made boxing and beauty pageants just as popular. Boxing legend Manny Pacquiao is still the country's most popular athlete.

Tennis has historically been much less popular - until Eala burst onto the scene.

body.zh: 为了追逐成为世界网球冠军的梦想，青少年运动员玛丽斯特拉·托雷坎波 (Maristella Torrecampo) 和她的父亲从她沉睡的山坡家乡乘坐 13 小时的巴士，前往马尼拉参加她最近的一场比赛。 这位 14 岁女孩的妈妈和四个兄弟姐妹无法一起观看她的比赛；她的众筹预算只够两张往返巴士票和几天的伙食费。 长途跋涉后，托雷坎波几乎没有休息，只有父亲为她加油，在那个闷热的周二下午，托雷坎波在黎刹体育场以 6-1 和 6-1 直落两盘击败了阿曼对手，继续追随该国新晋体育明星亚历山德拉·埃拉 (Alexandra Eala) 脚步的梦想。 托雷坎波于 7 月在马尼拉参加比赛，当时菲律宾正在庆祝埃拉历史性的温布尔登之旅 - 托雷坎波和整个国家都在流媒体和社交媒体上关注这一赛事。 21岁的埃拉是菲律宾选手在大满贯赛事中走得最远的选手，进入第四轮并一路淘汰了卫冕冠军波兰选手伊加·斯瓦泰克。 自从去年在迈阿密公开赛半决赛中取得突破性表现以来，埃拉重新点燃了菲律宾人对网球的兴趣，这个国家痴迷于篮球、拳击和选美皇后这三个B。 “就像阿特·亚历克斯一样，我想在温布尔登、WTA和世界各地的各种锦标赛上获胜，”托雷坎波说，他指的是埃拉，菲律宾语中的“姐姐”一词。 “她给了我很大的启发。我从小就很尊敬她，”曾参加过菲律宾全运会、柬埔寨和斯里兰卡的锦标赛的托雷坎波说道。 “我喜欢她在场外和场上的态度。场外，她真的很谦虚。有很多像我这样的孩子尊敬她。” 埃拉从伦敦回国后受到了英雄般的欢迎，费迪南德·马科斯总统在马尼拉马拉卡南宫为她举办了招待会。 埃拉在招待会上说：“我非常感激能够与全国分享我的胜利，尤其是我最近在温布尔登的胜利。” “正如我们所说，这是我们的胜利。看到我的进步受到菲律宾人民的认可，我无法形容我是多么高兴。” 网球是菲律宾这个拥有 1.12 亿人口的群岛国家的一项精英运动。 几十年的美国殖民统治给这个国家留下了对篮球的热情。每个村庄都有一个篮球场，菲律宾人比罗杰·费德勒更有可能认识勒布朗·詹姆斯。 菲律宾人对白手起家的失败故事和大人物的热爱也使得拳击和选美比赛同样受欢迎。拳击传奇人物曼尼·帕奎奥仍然是该国最受欢迎的运动员。 网球在历史上一直不太受欢迎——直到埃拉突然出现。 但这也暴露了它的难度有多大……

reflection.en: The success of Alex Eala at Wimbledon has inspired a nation to embrace a new sport, demonstrating how dedication in one's craft can ignite widespread enthusiasm. This echoes the spirit of striving for a prize, as described in Scripture, encouraging us to pursue our callings with excellence. When we commit ourselves wholeheartedly, our efforts can inspire...
reflection.zh: 亚历克斯·埃亚拉在温布尔登的成功激励了一个国家去拥抱一项新的运动，展现了在自己领域中的奉献如何能点燃广泛的热情。这与经文中所描述的为奖赏而奔跑的精神相呼应，鼓励我们以卓越的态度追求自己的使命。当我们全心投入时，我们的努力能够激励他人发现自己的潜力和喜悦。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Police investigate payments to Reform UK first revealed by The Guardian

body.en:
Payments to Reform UK first revealed by the Guardian are now being investigated by the Metropolitan police .

The inquiry is scrutinising payments made to the party via a company controlled by its deputy leader, Richard Tice.

Scotland Yard is looking at two donations of £250,000 made to the party by Britain Means Business in the weeks before the 2024 general election.

The Guardian revealed earlier this month that Fiona Cottrell made a £1m transfer to Britain Means Business shortly before the donations were made. About half of the funds were then passed to the party.

Cottrell’s son, George, is a convicted fraudster with close links to Reform’s leader, Nigel Farage .

The Guardian reported earlier this month that Fiona and George Cottrell have been interviewed under criminal caution as part of the police investigation.

In response to a query about the investigation from the BBC, Tice said: “This is the first I have heard of it – if true why are the Met police briefing the BBC before contacting interested parties?

“Is the Met leadership now engaged in the widespread politically motivated smear campaign against Reform and its leaders?”

Fiona Cottrell also made two donations directly to the party, each worth £250,000, in May 2024. These are also within the scope of the Metropolitan police investigation.

Tice, who was elected to parliament after the poll, is the sole director of Britain Means Business.

He has previously confirmed that his company received donations from Fiona Cottrell but described reports about the money as a “politically motivated smear campaign”.

The Guardian told how the transfer from Fiona Cottrell to Britain Means Business was reported to the National Crime Agency by bankers via a suspicious activity report.

Suspicious activity reports are not crime reports but exist to identify potential incidents of money laundering.

The Guardian understands that neither the NCA nor bankers have been able to trace the source of the original £1m sent by Fiona Cottrell to Tice’s company. The NCA is seeking help from a foreign partner in its attempts to understand where the money originated.

A Reform UK spokesperson said: “Reform takes pride in its stringent vetting of donations and always ensures that the Electoral Commission guidelines on donations, as set out in the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000, are strictly followed, as has been the case with donations so far.”

Fiona Cottrell did not respond to the Guardian’s attempts to contact her about the donations to Britain Means Business.

When asked about the developments by the BBC on Saturday evening, the Metropolitan police repeated a statement issued earlier this month.

body.en:
India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has called off its five-week-long protest, hours after Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned.

The CJP has called it a win for democracy and thousands of jubilant supporters continue to celebrate at Jantar Mantar, the main protest venue in Delhi.

An online satirical campaign with an AI-generated cockroach as its mascot, the CJP is not a real party but has evolved into a powerful platform for young people's anxieties and dissent.

The protest has been the most visible expression of public anger against PM Narendra Modi's government in recent years and gained momentum after Monday's police crackdown on people marching to parliament left dozens injured .

Pradhan announced his resignation on X in a post in Hindi saying he "respected the aspirations, dreams, and expectations of the youth" and was "pained by the events" of the past few days.

"Considering the situation at Jantar Mantar and across the country - with the aim of preventing anti-national forces from exploiting it, preserving national unity, ensuring that not a single Indian student's future gets entangled in legal complexities, and allowing our children to devote their time to studies and focus on building their careers - I have submitted my resignation to the prime minister," he wrote.

As news of Pradhan's resignation broke, a visibly emotional Abhijeet Dipke, CJP's founder, screamed from the makeshift stage at Jantar Mantar: "We have done it."

A loud cheer went up and huge celebrations erupted with the protesters singing, dancing, shouting slogans and handing out sweets.

Several hours since the CJP announced the end of their protest and its leaders left the site, crowds were still gathered at the venue into the night.

Many told the BBC they had waited for this day for weeks, and were not in the mood to leave without celebrating.

The site is increasingly looking like the centre of a party, with volunteers doing their best to manage the crowds. A large number of police are deployed around the area, but they say they will intervene only if they see breaches of the law.

The CJP was formed after the chief justice of India described some unemployed young people turning to journalism and activism as "cockroaches". He later said he was referring specifically to people with "fake and bogus degrees", but by then, the term had taken a life on its own.

The movement is led by Abhijeet Dipke, a 30-year-old political communications strategist and former student at Boston University.

The CJP quickly gained a huge following online, turning one of the most reviled insects into a symbol of defiance and resilience with 26 million followers on Instagram.

title.en: Serbia's LGBTQ+ community faces 'epidemic of violence'
title.zh: 塞尔维亚LGBTQ+群体面临“暴力疫情”

summary.en: Documented cases of violence against LGBTQ+ people in Serbia have reached unprecedented levels, reflecting a broader societal trend of targeting marginalized communities.
summary.zh: 塞尔维亚针对LGBTQ+群体的暴力案件数量创历史新高，这反映了社会针对边缘人群的普遍趋势。

body.en:
Documented cases of violence against LGBTQ+ people in Serbia have never been higher. The attacks are part of a larger shift in society targeting marginalized people.

Amid a slew of blows and homophobic insults, the woman on the bus lashed out at Aleksandar Savic and stabbed him with a sharp object. Later, in the emergency room, doctors treated Savic for a cut to the calf and injuries to his eye.

Incidents like the July 11 attack on Savic — also know as drag queen Alexis Plastik — don't happen often in Belgrade . But violence against people who don't look or act like the mainstream in the EU candidate country is becoming increasingly common.

Just a few hours earlier, Vladimir Arsenijevic, author and program director of the annual Krokodil Literary Festival, was attacked in central Belgrade in the middle of the day by right-wing thugs, as he was preparing for a memorial event commemorating the 1995 Srebrenica genocide .

Speaking with broadcaster N1, Plastik called out the "epidemic of violence" in Serbia . The increasing violence by groups associated with President Aleksandar Vucic and his Serbian Progressive Party, SNS, has reinforced the feeling among many people that anyone who is different can become a target, and that no one is safe.

"Violence is becoming increasingly normal, while protection against it is anything but guaranteed — especially for those who speak out against social or political problems, or who are unpopular with the general public," said Matija Stefanovic, the program coordinator for the LGBTQ+ group Da se Zna! ("For Your Information!"), which documents violence against queer people in Serbia.

"The fact that most of these attacks aren't investigated and that the perpetrators are rarely held accountable means they can't be dismissed as isolated incidents," said Stefanovic. "They represent a systemic problem that further stokes violence and emboldens perpetrators to continue attacking marginalized people, without having to fear significant consequences."

The social climate has become decidedly harsher for Serbia's LGBTQ+ community  over the last few years, with the community also increasingly the target of right-wing nationalist government.

Da se Zna! is based in an unassuming office on a side street in the center of the Serbian capital. Aside from a lone rainbow-colored nutcracker standing on a shelf, hardly anything indicates the group's purpose: it's the only organization in Serbia to document attacks on queer people — threats, vandalism, physical assault.

body.zh: 塞尔维亚针对 LGBTQ+ 人群的暴力案件记录从未如此之多。这些袭击是社会针对边缘人群的更大转变的一部分。 在一系列的殴打和仇视同性恋的侮辱中，公交车上的女子猛烈攻击亚历山大·萨维奇，并用锋利的物体刺伤了他。随后，在急诊室，医生对萨维奇的小腿割伤和眼睛受伤进行了治疗。 像 7 月 11 日对萨维奇（也被称为变装皇后亚历克西斯·普拉斯蒂克）的袭击这样的事件在贝尔格莱德并不经常发生。但针对那些看起来或行为不像欧盟候选国主流的人的暴力行为正变得越来越普遍。 就在几个小时前，年度鳄鱼文学节的作家兼节目总监弗拉基米尔·阿森尼耶维奇 (Vladimir Arsenijevic) 中午在贝尔格莱德市中心为纪念 1995 年斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝事件做纪念活动时遭到右翼暴徒袭击。 Plastik 在接受 N1 广播公司采访时指出了塞尔维亚的“暴力流行病”。与总统亚历山大·武契奇及其塞尔维亚进步党 SNS 有关的团体的暴力活动日益增多，加剧了许多人的感觉：任何不同的人都可能成为目标，没有人是安全的。 LGBTQ+ 团体 Da se Zna 的项目协调员马蒂亚·斯特凡诺维奇 (Matija Stefanovic) 表示：“暴力正变得越来越普遍，但防范暴力的措施却难以保证，特别是对于那些公开反对社会或政治问题，或者不受公众欢迎的人来说。” （“供您参考！”），记录了塞尔维亚针对酷儿群体的暴力行为。 斯特凡诺维奇说：“事实上，大多数袭击事件都没有受到调查，肇事者很少被追究责任，这意味着它们不能被视为孤立事件。” “它们代表了一个系统性问题，进一步煽动暴力，并鼓励肇事者继续攻击边缘化人群，而不必担心严重后果。” 在过去的几年里，塞尔维亚 LGBTQ+ 群体的社会气候明显变得更加严峻，该群体也越来越成为右翼民族主义政府的目标。 Da se Zna！总部设在塞尔维亚首都市中心一条小街上一间不起眼的办公室里。除了架子上孤独的彩虹色胡桃夹子外，几乎没有任何东西表明该组织的目的：它是塞尔维亚唯一记录对酷儿群体的攻击的组织——威胁、破坏公物、人身攻击。 “去年，我们统计了 110 例病例——比以往任何时候都多，”斯特凡诺维奇说。部分原因是该非政府组织越来越出名，酷儿群体也越来越愿意举报事件。但戏剧性的、备受瞩目的案件，比如……

title.en: More than 250,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain
title.zh: 法国和西班牙超过25万人逃离山火

summary.en: Spain's PM warns of "complex hours" ahead as authorities in France say they are far from bringing blazes burning near Bordeaux under control.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Firefighters are struggling to contain wildfires in south-west France as strong winds push flames towards the city of Bordeaux, with one official saying they "are far from having the fire under control."

More than 250,000 people in France and Spain have fled fires which have been raging for days, as winds and high temperatures hamper efforts to contain them. Overnight, seven towns west of Bordeaux were told to evacuate residents.

In Spain, where a state of emergency has been declared, a change in weather conditions has helped firefighters outside Madrid.

Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez admitted there are "complex times ahead". Meanwhile, authorities in València confirmed the death of a man in a fire.

The man, believed to be in his 70s, was found dead in his car by firefighters as they extinguished a fire in the Salt de l'Aigua ravine in Manises, according to local media reports.

In France, around 200,000 people have been evacuated in south-western regions of Gironde and Landes regions.

France has mobilised its military to help with the response and extra reinforcements from the army have been sent to help firefighters by clearing brush and creating fire breaks.

As of Saturday morning, the wildfire was around 40km to 50km (25 to 30 miles) away from Bordeaux. Still, the wind was blowing smoke towards the city and people reported an acrid smell in the air.

One tourist who fled an approaching wildfire near Bordeaux with his family described the scale of the blaze as "frightening".

Spencer Randall told the BBC his family evacuated in the early hours of Saturday to an area 100 miles east, but they can "still smell the wildfires from here".

A British couple holidaying in Bordeaux said they noticed the flames get worse on Friday night, as the fire approached.

"At about seven o'clock you could smell smoke. We thought someone was having a barbecue," Maisie told BBC Newsbeat from their holiday rental.

Her partner, Caleb, said the ash has now covered the pool in the house and turned their feet black when walking outside.

Nearby, in Saint-Aubin-de-Médoc, residents evacuating said the situation was "stressful", with one local describing it a "disaster".

The final leg of the Tour de France, due to take place Sunday, has been shortened from 133km (83 miles) to 89km (55 miles) so that security forces can be redeployed to areas affected by wildfires, organisers and police have said.

French President Emmanuel Macron is set to have an emergency meeting with ministers as 30 or so fires rage across the country - a situation which the government said is totally unprecedented.

In Spain, fires continued near Madrid but the regional government said there had been some progress.

title.en: Tour de France final stage shortened due to wildfires
title.zh: 环法自行车赛最后赛段因山火而缩短

summary.en: Security personnel assigned to the race have been redeployed to help contain major blazes near Bordeaux, reducing Sunday's final stage.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Security personnel assigned to the race have been redeployed to help contain major blazes near Bordeaux, reducing Sunday's final stage.

Sunday's final stage of the Tour de France will be shorter than planned because security forces have been redirected to help fight wildfires near Bordeaux, organizers and police said Saturday.

"In a spirit of national solidarity with the areas and communities affected, it was decided to adapt the route for the final stage from Thoiry to Paris," the Paris police and the event's organizers said in a joint statement.

Slovenian four-time champion Tadej Pogacar has all but sealed victory in the world-famous cycling race and only needs to finish Saturday's stage to secure a fifth Tour title in seven years.

The route for Stage 21 has been shortened to 89 kilometers (55 miles), down from the 133 kilometers originally planned.

It was set to begin east of Paris in Thoiry but will now start with two laps on the Champs-Elysees.

Riders will then race the circuit before finishing on the Champs-Elysees as usual.

The team presentation will still be held in Thoiry before riders are taken to Paris by bus.

"The Paris police prefect and the Tour de France director salute the commitment of all the actors mobilized in the fight against the fires and express their full solidarity with the affected populations," the statement said.

Wildfires near Arcachon Bay, near Bordeaux in Gironde, and around Biscarrosse in Landes have destroyed more than 36,000 hectares of forest and forced nearly 200,000 people to evacuate.

title.en: Dozens dead after buses collide in eastern Syria
title.zh: 叙利亚东部巴士相撞致数十人死亡

summary.en: A bus collision on a notoriously dangerous route in eastern Syria has resulted in dozens of fatalities, prompting a significant rescue effort.
summary.zh: 在叙利亚东部一条以事故频发而闻名的路线上，发生了一起公共汽车相撞事故，造成数十人死亡，并引发了大规模救援行动。

body.en:
The crash on a route notorious for deadly accidents prompted a large-scale rescue operation.

At least 35 people were killed and 30 others were injured when two buses collided in eastern Syria .

The crash happened on Saturday on a highway linking Damascus with Deir al-Zour province.

The Interior Ministry said one bus was carrying security personnel, while the other was carrying civilians.

State television footage showed one of the vehicles engulfed in flames after the impact.

Military helicopters were sent to the scene to help evacuate the injured and recover the bodies.

The route is widely known as the "road of death" because of its frequent and often deadly accidents.

title.en: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
title.zh: 特朗普在白宫记者晚宴上抨击新闻界

summary.en: Former President Donald Trump criticized journalists during the White House Correspondents' Dinner, an event that honored press freedom. The dinner was held after a previous event was canceled due to a shooting in April.
summary.zh: 前总统唐纳德·特朗普在白宫记者晚宴上抨击新闻界，该活动旨在庆祝新闻自由。此前，由于四月发生的一起枪击事件，第一次晚宴被取消。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump took swipes at the media at the White House Correspondents' Association (WHCA) dinner, a night celebrating press freedom, after the first event was cancelled by a shooting three months ago.

The president sat as reporters from outlets he has sparred with and even sued, including the New York Times, CNN and the Wall Street Journal, came up to be honoured with awards.

Typically the president takes a lighter-hearted tone at the annual dinner, and Trump joked "the second time is always better" and praised the media - saying he respects "most of them".

But the tone shifted as he aimed barbs at "fake news" and accused many in the room of having "Trump Derangement Syndrome".

In her remarks, WHCA President Weijia Jiang of CBS News said the event would return to the scene of the April shooting, the Washington Hilton, next year. Friday's rescheduled event was held at the Waldorf Astoria a few miles away from that site, following criticisms that security at the Hilton was inadequate.

The outgoing WHCA head said she would "refuse to let an act of violence have the final word", referring to the gunman tackled at the first dinner in April.

The officer shot at the scene, officer Victor Gonzalez of the US Secret Service, was given an award by Trump for his actions on the night of the shooting .

"Just like my presidency, the second time is always better – and the third time will be better yet … I'm only kidding," Trump said, joking that he would run for a third term in office.

Trump stood and shook hands with award winners, including a Wall Street Journal team who was given an award for coverage of Trump's links to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein .

Ahead of the event, many in the White House press corps theorised that Trump - who often criticises many of the reporters seated just metres away in the room - would deliver a stern rebuke of the media.

Trump's speech included pointed insults directed at several journalists, some of whom were in the room. The harsher tone and personal attacks extended to Democratic politicians and celebrities as his hour-long speech also took aim at familiar targets.

"We settle our differences not with bullets, but with open and vigorous debate," Trump said. "And no deranged loser with a gun will ever change that. We can't let that ever happen."

Trump appeared to be in a good mood throughout the event, jokingly telling the media that "sometimes I really do think that some of you don't like me".

"This place [the dinner] is really the largest group of 'Trump derangement syndrome' people ever put together at one time," he said. "I suspect some of you are lucky that our last dinner was cut short...I was going to go after you."

The president joked the news industry would "be broke" after he leaves...

title.en: Could 'mesh networks' help overcome authoritarians' internet blocks?
title.zh: “网状网络”能否帮助克服威权国家的互联网封锁？

summary.en: In countries with authoritarian governments, online communications are frequently monitored or shut down during political crises. However, activists are exploring alternative methods, such as 'mesh networks,' to maintain contact and circumvent state control.
summary.zh: 在威权国家，政府经常监控在线通信，或在政治危机期间切断网络。但活动家们正在探索其他方式，例如“网状网络”，以保持联系并规避国家控制。

body.en:
In authoritarian countries, the state is often either monitoring online communications or has the ability to shut them down in a political crisis. But there are other ways that activists can keep in touch.

Iran, January 2026: During some of the country's largest protests in decades, the Iranian government shut down the internet.

US-based internet monitor, IODA — short for Internet Outage Detection and Analysis — registered almost no data traffic at all and US internet infrastructure analyst Doug Madory described it as "one of the largest government-directed communication shutdowns in history."

During that time, the Iranian government killed and arrested thousands of people but to this day, nobody knows exactly how many. Estimates of the death toll have been anywhere between 7,000 and 40,000, though many observers suspect its closer to the higher number. The lack of clarity is partially because the internet blackout meant that communication with the outside world was all but impossible.

The Iranian government's behavior is not unusual . In Russia, Belarus, Myanmar and Sudan, particularly when governments fear resistance, the internet has become a weapon — because those who cannot communicate cannot organize.

One solution for these sorts of communications crises could be what is known as a "LoRa mesh network."

LoRa, which is short for "long range," is based on a simple principle invented for industrial purposes. Small radio modules, also known as LoRa transmitters, have regularly been embedded into physical silicon chips that are used for industrial devices that connect to the internet , things such as smoke alarms, smart water or power meters and environmental sensors — basically any device that requires long battery life and long-range data transmission but only for small amounts of data.

To transmit information, these devices use license-free radio frequencies of the sort available for civilian use, the same frequencies used by weather stations and garage door openers.

To form an internet-free communications network, users first need to purchase a transmitting device that uses LoRa; these can cost anything from about €30 ($35) to €80 ($91). Then users can connect their phone to the device using special software.

The LoRa devices transmit encrypted data packets over a distance of several kilometers. Each device automatically forwards messages to the next one, like a baton being passed through a crowd. If any single device fails, the message finds the next nearby device, via a different route. This means the communications network that is formed can repair itself.

title.en: 'We have done it': India's 'cockroach' movement notches up a major victory
title.zh: “我们做到了”：印度“蟑螂”运动取得重大胜利

summary.en: A significant protest movement in India has achieved a major success with the resignation of a minister, fulfilling one of its primary demands after months of demonstrations.
summary.zh: 印度一场声势浩大的抗议运动取得了重大胜利，一名部长辞职，满足了该运动数月来提出的一个关键诉求。

body.en:
Indian ‌education minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned, handing a major ‌victory to youth protesters nationwide who had demanded that he quit ‌to take responsibility for examination paper leaks.

The minister announced his resignation on Saturday just as police fired tear gas to scatter young protesters in New Delhi, hours before their leaders were set ‌to hold ‌another ⁠round of talks with ministers.

"Considering the situation that has arisen at Jantar Mantar and across the country, so that anti-national forces do not take advantage of this situation ... I have sent my resignation letter to the prime minister," Pradhan wrote in a ⁠post on X.

"I deeply respect the aspirations, ‌feelings, and legitimate expectations of the country's youth."

Cheers erupted among the thousands of protesters ‌who have been rallying in central Delhi and elsewhere as the news spread.

"We have done it," said Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party that led the protests, to loud cheers at the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi.

Youngsters at the site shouted "Jai Hind", a patriotic slogan meaning "Victory to India".

India's youth-led "cockroach" movement began in May after a supreme court chief justice compared some unemployed young people to "cockroaches" and "parasites" during a hearing on another issue.

In early June, a series of exam leaks that forced millions to retake a gruelling, high-stakes medical entrance exam sparked the movement's first offline protests.

The protests have continued since then, but anger boiled over after police on Monday injured dozens of students, launching baton charges ‌and firing tear gas to deter crowds of protesters marching on parliament.

Federal authorities on Saturday restricted access to the internet and to 18 metro stations to try to limit the protest in New Delhi.

In recent days, Indians in Australia have gathered in solidarity with those back home.

The protests also reflect anger over job scarcity, corruption and government accountability.

Despite rapid economic growth, millions of people in the world's most populous nation struggle to find stable and well-paying jobs, fuelling discontent.

According to a recent study, almost 40 per cent of India's graduates below the age of 25 are unemployed.

body.en:
Financial analysts have warned not to expect much stability in Tesla's share price after CEO Elon Musk defended billions of dollars of investment at the electric vehicle manufacturer, which has just seen one of its worst stock market falls in years.

This week, Tesla reported second-quarter profit of $US1.1 billion ($1.57 billion), down about 5 per cent from a year earlier, as lower vehicle prices and heavy investment in artificial intelligence weighed on the company's earnings.

The result translated to 33 cents a share, well below analysts' expectations of 53 cents, while revenue rose 26 per cent to $28.2 billion.

Although Tesla beat expectations for second-quarter vehicle deliveries earlier this month, the company said profitability was hit by lower vehicle selling prices, reduced revenue from regulatory credits and unspecified "energy warranty-related charges".

Capital expenditure more than doubled to $5.8 billion ($8.3 billion) during the quarter as Tesla accelerated investment in AI and manufacturing.

Tesla is embarking on a massive construction spree that Musk characterised on a conference call as probably the United States' "fastest industrial scale-up since World War Two".

The company said production of its Cybercab had begun in Texas, the Tesla Semi remained on track for 2026, and subscriptions to its Full Self-Driving driver-assistance program continued to grow.

Asked about scaling Tesla's robotaxi business, Musk said the company was focused on achieving near-perfect reliability.

"How many nines of reliability do you need to scale?" Musk said. "Ideally, you want 99.99999, you know, per cent reliable."

Tesla's spending has drawn scrutiny from investors concerned about returns on its AI investments.

CFRA Research analyst Garrett Nelson said uncertainty over the spending had weighed on Tesla shares.

"They just haven't been very transparent with [Wall] Street on the expected return of the dollars that have been spent."

Jai Mirchandani, chief executive of Elm Responsible Investments, said the spending reflected Tesla's long-term strategy.

"The company and Musk is saying that it's one of the best investment opportunities and that's why they're investing so heavily in AI and robotics primarily," he told SBS News.

"As we've seen from companies like even Google and Microsoft and all the tech leaders, it's very expensive, and it requires a lot of capital to build the AI infrastructure and technology.

"And if you want to succeed in this space, our view is that you have to be investing in AI and innovation."

title.en: Decades after being adopted, Vanessa learned she'd been 'sold' by a criminal network
title.zh: 凡妮莎在被收养数十年后得知自己被一个犯罪网络“贩卖”

summary.en: Vanessa is among dozens across the world who have been linked to a single illegal overseas adoption network.
summary.zh: 凡妮莎是全球数十名与同一个非法海外收养网络有关联的人之一。

body.en:
For most of her life, Vanessa Miles believed the official documents that accompanied her adoption from Taiwan told the story of who she was.

The 46-year-old Adelaide woman was adopted by an Australian couple when she was just three months old.

She had kept her birth certificate and Taiwanese passport, and later discovered she was connected to one of Taiwan's most notorious illegal international adoption scandals.

"The details around my adoption and my birth are quite unknown. Unfortunately, I was sold as a small baby by a woman named Chu Li-ching and an illegal adoption network," she said.

To this day, she has been unable to find her biological mother, and her birth documents have only become part of the mystery.

The alleged masterminds, Chu Li-ching and her husband, were accused of falsifying babies' identities and illegally arranging overseas adoptions.

Some of the children involved came from disadvantaged families or were voluntarily relinquished by single mothers unable to raise them.

At least 63 babies were reportedly sent to families in Australia, the United States and Europe.

It was only last year, after beginning an online search into her past, that Miles realised she was among them.

"From my baby Taiwanese passport, I know that I was one of the Chu Li-ching babies," Miles said.

International Social Service Australia deputy CEO Damon Martin said many adoptive families had assumed the documents they received from overseas agencies were legitimate.

After discovering their paperwork was fraudulent, adoptees trying to trace their origins faced an enormous challenge, he said.

"It's extremely difficult, especially if there's fraudulent papers or there's been illicit activities. It's difficult to find someone when you don't know their name," he said.

Miles' birth certificate lists her name as Wen and identifies her mother as Li Mei.

Hoping those details would lead her to the truth, she travelled to Taiwan for the first time in May 2025.

"We went to the police station where I left my DNA hoping for a match, and I also met with the competent authority, and I spoke in front of the media. However, none of these avenues returned any result," Miles said.

After returning to Australia, Miles also applied for a Taiwanese passport, believing her original baby passport would make the process straightforward.

"However, after a period of time, it was discovered that there was actually another woman with the same name as me: Wen, the daughter of Li Mei," Miles said.

Meanwhile, Taiwanese officials contacted Li Mei, who denied being Miles' birth mother and declined to undergo DNA testing.

For those like Vanessa, the very foundation of their family history is shaken by deceit and exploitation. Yet, Yahweh is described as a father to the fatherless, one who sets the lonely in families, offering a deep...
reflection.zh: 凡妮莎等人发现自己的收养竟是犯罪网络的一部分，这揭示了身份和归属感被严重侵犯的痛苦。当家庭历史的根基被欺骗和剥削动摇时，雅伟却被描述为孤儿的父，使孤独的有家。这在人类系统失灵时，仍能提供深刻的归属感和关怀。

verse.textEn: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling. God sets the lonely in families.
verse.textZh: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父，作寡妇的伸冤者。神叫孤独的有家。

title.en: How Chinese tech and Russian tactics are aiding Iran’s bombing of US bases
title.zh: 中国科技和俄罗斯战术如何助力伊朗轰炸美军基地

summary.en: A report indicates that Iran's attacks on US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf are becoming more accurate and lethal, with assistance from Chinese technology and Russian tactics. This escalation is revealing vulnerabilities in existing defenses in the region.
summary.zh: 一份报告指出，伊朗对海湾地区美军基地和关键基础设施的袭击正变得越来越精准和致命，这得益于中国的技术和俄罗斯的战术。此次升级暴露了该地区现有防御的弱点。

body.en: Increasingly accurate and lethal attacks are revealing weaknesses in stretched defences across the Gulf As the crisis in the Middle East escalates, Iran has been bombing US bases and critical infrastructure in the Gulf with increasing accuracy, helped by Chinese satellite imagery and tactics learned by Russia in Ukraine. Three US soldiers were killed last Friday in an attack on the Muwaffaq Salti airbase in Jordan, which was being protected by a Thaad air defence system. Satellite imagery later released by Iranian media showed several buildings had been destroyed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 越来越准确和致命的袭击暴露了整个海湾地区紧张防御的弱点随着中东危机升级，在中国卫星图像和俄罗斯在乌克兰学到的战术的帮助下，伊朗一直在以越来越高的精度轰炸美国在海湾的基地和关键基础设施。上周五，约旦穆瓦法克萨尔蒂空军基地遭到萨德防空系统保护，三名美国士兵在袭击中丧生。伊朗媒体后来发布的卫星图像显示，多座建筑物被毁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of escalating, more lethal attacks in the Gulf, aided by advanced technology, highlights the ongoing human tendency to refine the instruments of conflict. Isaiah's ancient vision of nations transforming weapons into tools for peace offers a profound contrast to the current reality of improving the means of war. It reminds us to long for a future...
reflection.zh: 海湾地区袭击升级，在先进技术辅助下变得更具杀伤力的消息，凸显了人类不断完善冲突工具的倾向。以赛亚书将武器转化为和平工具的古老愿景，与当前不断改进战争手段的现实形成了深刻对比。它提醒我们，要渴望一个将智慧用于建设而非毁灭的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Mass job cuts loom at VW as profits fall steeply on China sales slump
title.zh: 大众汽车因中国销量下滑利润锐减，面临大规模裁员

summary.en: Volkswagen has reported a significant drop in profits and reduced its revenue forecast, primarily due to a sales slump in China. The German carmaker is implementing a restructuring program that could lead to the elimination of 100,000 jobs globally.
summary.zh: 大众汽车公布利润大幅下滑并下调营收预期，主要原因是其在中国市场的销量锐减。这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项重组计划，可能导致全球裁员10万人。

body.en: Carmaker expects to sell 3% fewer vehicles this year as it pushes through a programme that could eliminate 100,000 roles Volkswagen has reported a steep fall in profits and cut its revenue forecast amid a sales slump in China, as the German carmaker pushes through a brutal cost-cutting programme that includes axeing up to 100,000 jobs. VW said it expects sales revenue to fall by up to 3% this year, a reversal of a previous forecast for a 3% increase on last year’s €321.9bn (£275.3bn), because of a sales slump in the highly competitive Chinese market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汽车制造商预计今年的汽车销量将减少 3%，因为该公司正在推行一项可能裁减 10 万名员工的计划。大众汽车公司报告称，由于中国销量下滑，大众汽车公司利润大幅下滑，并下调了收入预期，因为这家德国汽车制造商正在推行一项残酷的成本削减计划，其中包括裁员多达 10 万名。大众表示，由于竞争激烈的中国市场销量下滑，预计今年销售收入将下降 3%，与去年 3,219 亿欧元（2,753 亿英镑）相比增长 3% 的预测相反。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of economic uncertainty and job insecurity, it's easy to feel that our worth is tied to our employment. This verse reminds us that all work, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it a deeper purpose beyond earthly outcomes. For those facing job loss, remembering this truth can be a source of dignity and hope,...
reflection.zh: 在经济不确定和就业不稳的时期，我们很容易觉得自己的价值与工作挂钩。这节经文提醒我们，所有工作，只要勤勉正直地去做，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其拥有超越世俗结果的更深层意义。对于那些面临失业的人来说，记住这个真理可以成为尊严和希望的源泉，因为他们知道自己的劳动具有永恒的价值。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Weather tracker: More than 900 wildfires rage across Canada
title.zh: 天气追踪：加拿大900多处野火肆虐

summary.en: More than 900 wildfires are currently burning across Canada, with many out of control in the Northwest Territories and Ontario. Recent hot, dry weather has contributed to the fires, which have already scorched approximately 3 million hectares.
summary.zh: 加拿大目前有超过900处野火正在燃烧，其中西北地区和安大略省的许多火势仍未得到控制。近期炎热干燥的天气助长了火势，已烧毁约300万公顷土地。

body.en: Fires remain out of control in Northwest Territories and Ontario, while Argentina endures record night-time heat Recent hot, dry weather in Canada has triggered hundreds of wildfires across the country. As of Wednesday, more than 900 were burning, scorching about 3m hectares of land. While fires have broken out in several provinces, the greatest concern is in the Northwest Territories and Ontario , where several remain out of control. Poor air quality has been reported across affected regions, with wildfire smoke carried by winds into the US and even across the Atlantic to northern Europe. The risk of further blazes remains high as North America enters the peak of fire season. Continue reading...
body.zh: 西北地区和安大略省的火灾仍处于失控状态，而阿根廷则经历了创纪录的夜间高温。加拿大最近炎热干燥的天气在全国引发了数百起野火。截至周三，已有 900 多个火点在燃烧，烧焦了约 300 万公顷的土地。虽然多个省份都爆发了火灾，但最令人担忧的是西北地区和安大略省，其中有几处火灾仍处于失控状态。据报道，受影响地区的空气质量很差，野火烟雾随风进入美国，甚至跨越大西洋到达北欧。随着北美进入火灾季节高峰，进一步发生火灾的风险仍然很高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires across Canada, consuming millions of hectares, remind us of creation's deep vulnerability and its 'groaning' under the weight of environmental distress. In these moments of ecological crisis, we are called to lament with the Earth and seek ways to care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 加拿大各地蔓延的野火吞噬了数百万公顷土地，这提醒我们受造界的脆弱，以及它在环境困境重压下的“叹息”。在这些生态危机时刻，我们受召与大地一同哀叹，并寻求方法来照管雅伟托付给我们的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

Graylin 认为 Kimi K3 的到来将高端人工智能从昂贵的奢侈品变成了实用且负担得起的东西。 “对于 98% 的客户来说，[知识] 1% 到 2% 的差异并不值得多付 10 到 20 倍的费用。” 中国的最新进展已经引起华盛顿的强烈反应，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普现在威胁要阻止美国使用中国的人工智能模型。 与此同时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周早些时候警告称，美国可能会因涉嫌盗窃知识产权而制裁中国模型。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 指责中国实验室使用他们的模型来训练他们自己的系统，这一过程被称为蒸馏。 虽然提炼是全球人工智能实验室在一定程度上的常见做法，但这些公司表示，他们的模型已经受到查询的轰炸，以收获高级推理。白宫四月份警告说，中国正在以“工业规模”这样做。 北京方面予以反击，否认这些指控毫无根据，并称美国威胁实施制裁和示范禁令是“技术欺凌”，旨在遏制中国的崛起。 华盛顿智库史汀生中心战略远见中心的研究分析师朱莉娅·尼赫（Giulia Neaher）淡化了提炼在基米进步中的作用。 “[其成功]很大程度上归功于为建设这个项目而投入的人才、基础设施和资源......

reflection.en: In a world of intense technological competition and rising international tensions, the call to live peaceably with all people becomes profoundly relevant. Even amidst accusations and threats, seeking paths to de-escalation and mutual respect is vital for global stability. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to pursue peace wherever possible, even when faced with...
reflection.zh: 在科技竞争激烈、国际关系日益紧张的世界中，与所有人和平相处的呼召变得至关重要。即使面对指控和威胁，寻求缓和局势和相互尊重的途径对全球稳定也至关重要。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们，即使面对竞争，也要尽可能追求和平。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Democratic lawmakers propose bank funded by China tariffs to boost US manufacturing
title.zh: 民主党议员提议设立由对华关税资助的银行以提振美国制造业

summary.en: Democratic lawmakers have proposed creating a bank, funded by tariffs on China, to provide grants, loans, and investments for US manufacturing. This initiative aims to revitalize the country's industrial heartlands and support smaller businesses.
summary.zh: 民主党议员提议设立一家由对华关税资助的银行，旨在为美国制造业提供拨款、贷款和投资。这项举措旨在振兴美国的工业腹地并支持小型企业。

body.en: Exclusive: Ro Khanna says ‘reindustrialization’ effort would provide grants, loans and investments to smaller businesses Democrats in the US Congress have laid out plans for what they say would be the “boldest” bid to revitalize the country’s industrial heartlands since the second world war – using revenue raised by tariffs on China. A bill introduced this week would create a new bank to strengthen domestic manufacturing, provided with up to $15bn in funds each year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：罗·卡纳表示，“再工业化”努力将为小型企业提供赠款、贷款和投资。美国国会的民主党人已经制定了计划，他们称这是自二战以来“最大胆”的振兴美国工业中心地带的计划——利用对中国征收关税获得的收入。本周提出的一项法案将创建一家新银行来加强国内制造业，每年提供高达 150 亿美元的资金。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As lawmakers propose strategies to boost national manufacturing and economic strength, it is a reminder that Yahweh is the one who gives us the ability to produce wealth. This divine provision calls us to steward our economic endeavors with wisdom and purpose, recognizing that true prosperity ultimately comes from Him.

title.en: The Guardian view on Chinese workers picking up the pen: poetry in motion | Editorial

summary.en: A food delivery rider has won China's highest literary award, highlighting a growing trend of laborers engaging in creative writing. body.en: A food delivery rider has won the country’s highest literary award. It is part of a growing trend for writing by labourers The hundreds of millions who have built modern China from the ground up – sweeping its streets, labouring in its factories and ferrying its goods – are often overlooked. But they refuse to go unheard. Last week, a food delivery rider won China’s top literary award . Wang Jibing, 56, first caught attention when a poem about his experiences went viral in 2022. The following year, Hu Anyan’s memoir , I Deliver Parcels in Beijing, became a bestseller. In the early 20th century, Chinese intellectuals sought to capture the harsh realities of working-class lives. But it was under Mao Zedong that the idea of writing by as well as about the masses became reality, with labourers encouraged to take up the pen. In an era when the party tried to govern the language even of diaries and personal letters, the parameters of style and content were strict, and this enthusiasm swiftly diminished after Mao. title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

body.en:

"Everyone had straight blonde hair. I remember going to school, getting water from the bubbler and flattening all my hair down because it was just too much," she tells SBS News.

Inheriting her curls from her Spanish father, Vazquez says her mother, who is of Malaysian heritage, didn't have the tools or knowledge to style and manage curly hair .

Now a mother herself, she has watched her nine-year-old daughter, Ivory, who also has curly hair, face the same challenges of standing out among her peers at school.

She says she's determined to break the cycle and empower her daughter to feel confident about her appearance.

"I just have to embrace, educate and show her all the beautiful styles that are possible with curly hair."

For many Australians with curly, coily and afro-textured hair, finding a hairdresser with the right skills remains a challenge. Stylists say the problem starts in the classroom, where training has long failed to keep pace with the needs of textured hair.

Unlike straight hair, curly, coily, afro or textured hair has a different structure that requires specialised cutting techniques. Experienced stylists often cut textured hair while it is dry to better understand how the curls fall and frame the face.

Vazquez and her daughter travel nearly two hours to Curl Lab in Sydney, a salon specialising in curly hair cuts and education, but she says it took years of trial and error to find the right place.

"We went to one salon, and they straightened Ivory's hair and cut it. Unfortunately, her hair is never straight, so by the time we've gone home, showered, the curls bounced up and it was just chopped everywhere," she says.

Curl Lab owner Natasha Thandekafountas says the current hair education system teaches students the same cutting techniques for clients with both straight and textured or afro hair, rather than providing training tailored to different hair types.

"If you're cutting curly hair when it's straightened or wet, it's going to look good until the curls bounce up," Thandekafountas tells SBS News.

"We like to call it the 'Lord Farquaad' bob, so many clients come in for us to fix that," referring to the character from the film Shrek, who has a pageboy bob haircut.

The challenges faced by many people with curly and afro-textured hair are rooted in decades of beauty standards that experts say favoured straight hair.

body.en:
"We are proudly a progressive movement: two words that can't be applied to the escalator in this building," Anthony Albanese said to much mirth at Friday's Labor Party conference dinner.

The viral moment — in which the prime minister's descent came to a sudden, jolting stop, followed by an expletive-laden reaction — was one of the very few times this week that the veteran Labor party animal didn't appear to have a level of mastery over events that unfolded in Adelaide at Labor's once-a-term policy palooza.

"When it [the escalator] did come to a standstill, I'll admit there was a moment, just a moment, when the ladder of opportunity finally made sense," he said, riffing on former leader Mark Latham's ill-fated slogan from 2004, one of the party's more recent political low-points.

Two decades on, having achieved Labor's most powerful parliamentary majority in history, the prime minister said the party "can finally laugh about making him leader".

While the glow may have dimmed in the wider electorate, judging by recent polling, Albanese seemingly retained the halo of that 2025 election result among the delegates who 'debated' the party's platform this week.

The conference's myriad factions moved deftly to almost entirely avoid the passionate and public policy brawls of the past, which Albanese, the apex predator of the Labor left, used to once involve himself in.

All but one of the various amendments and motions was passed with unanimous support on the floor.

The sole outlier, a commitment for the government to remove barriers around using telehealth to access voluntary assisted dying (VAD), allowed a sole delegate to speak against the motion, the sole amendment to pass where some delegates voted against.

The party also enshrined in its constitution a conscience vote for MPs on this issue, similar to that allowed on abortion.

Trade Minister Don Farrell — a longtime Labor right power-broker who remains opposed to euthanasia — rejected suggestions debate was being suppressed among delegates.

"Far from a graveyard, this is a flowering of democracy," Farrell told the floor on Saturday to much applause.

For most of her life, Vanessa Miles believed the official documents that accompanied her adoption from Taiwan told the story of who she was.

The 46-year-old Adelaide woman was adopted by an Australian couple when she was just three months old.

She had kept her birth certificate and Taiwanese passport, and later discovered she was connected to one of Taiwan's most notorious illegal international adoption scandals.

"The details around my adoption and my birth are quite unknown. Unfortunately, I was sold as a small baby by a woman named Chu Li-ching and an illegal adoption network," she said.

To this day, she has been unable to find her biological mother, and her birth documents have only become part of the mystery.

The alleged masterminds, Chu Li-ching and her husband, were accused of falsifying babies' identities and illegally arranging overseas adoptions.

Some of the children involved came from disadvantaged families or were voluntarily relinquished by single mothers unable to raise them.

At least 63 babies were reportedly sent to families in Australia, the United States and Europe.

It was only last year, after beginning an online search into her past, that Miles realised she was among them.

"From my baby Taiwanese passport, I know that I was one of the Chu Li-ching babies," Miles said.

International Social Service Australia deputy CEO Damon Martin said many adoptive families had assumed the documents they received from overseas agencies were legitimate.

After discovering their paperwork was fraudulent, adoptees trying to trace their origins faced an enormous challenge, he said.

"It's extremely difficult, especially if there's fraudulent papers or there's been illicit activities. It's difficult to find someone when you don't know their name," he said.

Miles' birth certificate lists her name as Wen and identifies her mother as Li Mei.

Hoping those details would lead her to the truth, she travelled to Taiwan for the first time in May 2025.

"We went to the police station where I left my DNA hoping for a match, and I also met with the competent authority, and I spoke in front of the media. However, none of these avenues returned any result," Miles said.

After returning to Australia, Miles also applied for a Taiwanese passport, believing her original baby passport would make the process straightforward.

"However, after a period of time, it was discovered that there was actually another woman with the same name as me: Wen, the daughter of Li Mei," Miles said.

Meanwhile, Taiwanese officials contacted Li Mei, who denied being Miles' birth mother and declined to undergo DNA testing.

body.en:
Higher prices at the bowser are likely to continue to flow to motorists, experts say, with the Houthi rebels widening the front line of conflict in the Middle East and little sign of an imminent détente between the United States and Iran.

The Houthis had accused US ally Saudi Arabia of a "dangerous escalation" after it struck military targets belonging to the group on Friday, following the rebels announcing a maritime blockade of the top oil producer and hitting its ships in the Red Sea.

The flare-up marks a new front in a war that has engulfed the region following US-Israeli strikes on Tehran in February, and comes on top of Iran's parallel blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh's only other maritime route.

Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment on the Houthis' Ansarollah media post on Telegram on Saturday that a "Yemeni missile strike" had sparked fires in Jizan. But Riyadh's civil defence agency issued brief warnings to residents in the city — as well as another city, Yanbu — early on Saturday.

The warning came after the Saudi-led coalition said Friday it had hit Houthi sites and destroyed targets threatening commercial vessels in response to attacks on Red Sea shipping.

A Yemeni security source told AFP a naval base in the port city of Hodeida and a military camp on Kamaran island were among the Saudi targets.

The Houthis claimed attacks on two Saudi ships earlier this week, with Saudi Arabia confirming one of the attacks in the Red Sea.

The escalation came after Trump suggested he was holding off on a major operation as Tehran was now getting "serious" in talks with Washington.

"No, I haven't," Trump told journalists in the Oval Office when asked if he had made a decision on hitting Iran hard, for now dialling back reports that he was increasingly frustrated with the war and mulling a large-scale military operation.

"We are talking to them. ‌I think they're being serious. I think ... they are being by far the most serious that we've seen them, but that doesn't mean we get there," Trump told reporters at the White House.

Trump has in recent days threatened to expand targets being struck in Iran to include energy plants and bridges, to send ground forces to seize its Kharg Island oil hub and to bomb a deep-underground nuclear-linked site known as Pickaxe Mountain.

Trump told Axios on ‌Thursday that he was considering relaunching major combat against Iran. "They haven't received enough pain yet," the US news outlet quoted him as saying.

title.en: 2026 Census Australia: Key dates, what's included and why it matters
title.zh: 2026年澳大利亚人口普查：关键日期、普查内容及重要性

summary.en: Australia is preparing for its 2026 Census on Tuesday, August 11, a national count where every person is included, and experts stress the importance of each response for national planning.

body.en:
Every five years, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) counts every person and every household in the country as part of the Census of Population and Housing.

That includes Australians, young and old, from metropolitan and rural Australia. Even holidaymakers, international students and temporary visa holders are counted on Census night. It's often referred to as the most comprehensive snapshot of Australia, akin to a family photograph of the country.

Emily Walter, Census national spokesperson at the ABS, said it's about more than just numbers. She believes the Census tells a story of a changing Australia.

"Our Census provides a snapshot of the country at a point in time ... So, it's really important that absolutely everyone is reflected in the Census," she told SBS Urdu.

"It is compulsory for that very good reason, and it's important that we get a very accurate count of the number of people in Australia ... because it's about providing data for the country to help serve the country."

The first population count in Australia dates back to 1788. In 1911, the ABS ran its first national Census, with field officers travelling by horse or bicycle to collect information about Australians.

Today, the Census is available online and by paper and can also be completed with help from Census field staff.

It's compulsory for everyone in Australia to complete the Census. Generally, one person from each household completes the Census — although you can ask for separate forms for privacy reasons.

If an Australian is overseas on Census night, they don't need to complete the Census.

The ABS collects personal information about individuals, including age, country of birth, cultural background, living situation, work and education. Some questions about religious affiliation, gender and sexual orientation (for people aged 16 and over) will be optional.

Census data is used to inform decisions about language services, settlement support, transport, schools, health care, infrastructure and business. It also helps plan local services for individuals, families and communities.

SBS broadcasts and publishes across more than 60 languages, using data from the Census to ensure its audio, digital, and television offerings reflect the country's evolving demographics.

The data is often used by researchers to study a range of topics, including population demographics, economic trends and social issues.

Liz Allen, a demographer at the Australian National University's Centre for Social Policy Research, said the Census provides an "important suite of information" for decision-makers.
